Database.//: Provider is Sqlite or Oracle. For production set Provider=Oracle and supply a real ConnectionString (e.g. via environment variable Database__ConnectionString or a secret store). Seed must be false against a real database.
Database.//MaxIdTables: Tables whose id is assigned MAX(id)+1 (no Oracle sequence) — the legacy behaviour. The security admin tables have no *_id_seq in the legacy schema (PB assigned user_id/group_id/application_id via MAX+1), so listing them here avoids ORA-02289 on create. The AbisSchema-provisioned tables (sales-quote + abis_* owned tables) create NO sequence, so every one that assigns its id via NextIdAsync must be listed here or it 500s on Oracle (ORA-02289). abis_truck_appointment is the concrete case; abis_scheduled_job/abis_job_run currently use inline MAX+1 but are listed for safety.

ApiKeys.//: Supply keys via configuration/secret (e.g. ApiKeys__Keys__0). Set Enabled=false only on a trusted internal network.

WinSpc.//: Read-only connector to the plant WinSPC (SQL Server) quality DB on RSEDAM-PC. Disabled by default. To enable: set Enabled=true and supply a read-only ConnectionString (e.g. WinSpc__ConnectionString='Server=rsedam-pc\SQLEXPRESS;Database=WinSPC;User Id=abis_ro;Password=...;TrustServerCertificate=True'). Provider=Sqlite is for the test mimic only. Job/Coil tag patterns match WinSPC's free-text tag names.

Audit.//: Set Enabled=false when the target schema has no compatible audit table (the live DBO schema has no opc_action_log). Otherwise auditing self-disables after the first write failure.

Email.//: TEST PHASE: OverrideRecipient redirects EVERY email (automated/triggered/manual) to this one inbox — real recipients are preserved in the subject/body. Clear it (empty) ONLY at the production cutover. Smtp.Host empty = log-only (nothing sent); set it to the plant relay to actually deliver.
Email.//SendTestOnStartup: Set true (e.g. Email__SendTestOnStartup=true) to send one diagnostic email through the full pipeline at startup — a deploy-time smoke test. Logs the redirect when Smtp.Host is empty; delivers once the relay is set. Default off.
